encoder.input: Exact original mono16kHz64000 float32 samples; no normalization, denoising, padding or resampling
encoder.pooling: Layer order4,8,12; each masked population mean then standard deviation; float32
encoder.runtime: CPU float32, eager attention, eval, all parameters frozen; no custom remote code
encoder.weight_terms: Model-card-linked UniSpeech CC-BY-SA-3.0; retain attribution/share-alike. Separate unilm code MIT.

method.assessment: Keep prior speech admission, interval readout and genuine-only calibration. Run each trained model on one submitted clip at a time.
method.clock: Limit control windows to those usefully overlapping the same labeled edit clock. Use controls only during fitting and evaluation.
method.inputs: Same frozen encoder, small two-output network, 16 epochs, and independent family and speaker roles as the prior study.
method.loss: Add 0.45 times softplus(0.5 + highest control proposal - best useful synthetic proposal) on admitted matched sets. Exclude sets lacking either a supported positive or an eligible control from this loss.
method.target: Rank a speech-admitted, truth-overlapping half-to-one-second window from the synthetic clip above the strongest window in its three matched genuine clips and isolated background.
method.whole_file: Consider every eligible proposal in each of the four control files. Add the same rank loss with the same margin and weight.
